cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

The historical CLI default discarded non-ASCII characters and did not escape
CSV delimiters. The prepared default switch fixed those two diagnostic cases,
but not carriage-return quoting. The finished default preserves input order,
Unicode, whitespace, and escapes commas, quotes, CR and LF.

These are executable component comparisons, not instruction-following or model
policy experiments. No historical policy instruction is available. The baseline
is the exact initial app in `eval/baseline.mjs`; `baseline` is also an explicit
component configuration. No policy, provider, token, or recovery claims are made.

Reviewed actual stdout, stderr, exit status, inputs, expected output, ratings,
reasons and SHA-256 source identities are in `eval/results.json`. Failed prepared
observations are retained separately in `eval/prepared-results.json` (different
app/runner hashes). The old local two-case capture had a stale source hash and
is not used as evidence. Private local runtime metadata is omitted entirely;
these runs use only the public task data checked into `eval/cases.json`.

| Case | Historical / baseline | Prepared default/full | Finished default/full | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| unicode | fail | pass | pass | fail | pass |
| escaping | fail | pass | pass | pass | fail |
| order | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| line-breaks | fail | fail | pass | pass | fail |
| trailing-space | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| empty | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| mixed | fail | pass | pass | fail | fail |

Failures are exact CSV output mismatches, not infrastructure errors. All recorded
processes exited successfully. Prepared without-Unicode also failed line-breaks.
The final change improves on the prepared revision only on the CR case here;
ablation failures alone are not evidence of that improvement. These seven
correlated cases are regression diagnostics and synthetic edge coverage, not
independent workload samples or a reliability estimate. The two original cases
were reused; additional cases were not held-out validation after tuning.

## Reproduce (Node.js, no dependencies or network)

- `node eval/run.mjs --replay eval/results.json`: verify current hashes and replay
  all saved grades without executing candidates.
- `node eval/run.mjs --replay-saved eval/prepared-results.json`: replay old grades
  while explicitly not asserting current source identity.
- `node eval/run.mjs --run tmp/fresh.json`: fresh production run; first create
  `tmp/`. The destination must not exist. Raw local reruns belong in ignored tmp.

Inputs, conditions, grader and source hashes are frozen before subprocess calls;
conditions are interleaved per case. Grader self-tests run first. Canonical exact
stdout (including final LF) is the acceptance contract; semantically equivalent
optional quoting is deliberately rejected. No stdout trimming is allowed.
Settings: local Node runtime recorded per run, 5-second subprocess timeout,
JSON-array inputs, String conversion, comma separator, LF record terminator.
Runtime/timeout errors are classified separately from output mismatches.
No manual grading or model calls are required. Inspect the case table and actual
stdout fields for local review. Source drift blocks normal replay.
EOF
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

The default is `full`: Unicode is preserved, CSV special characters are quoted,
and input column order is unchanged. Output is one LF-terminated CSV record.
See `REPORT.md` for the checked-in regression suite and replay commands.
EOF

+const variant = process.argv[3] || 'baseline';
+const values = JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);
+const output = values.map(value => {
+  let text = String(value);
+  if (['baseline', 'without-unicode'].includes(variant)) text = text.replace(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g, '');
+  if (!['baseline', 'without-escaping'].includes(variant) && /[",\n]/.test(text)) text = '"' + text.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"';
+  return text;
+}).join(',');

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

+process.chdir(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
+const hash = data => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
+// Canonical serialization contract: exact stdout including its final LF.
+function grade(actual, expected, status, error) {
+  if (error || status !== 0) return {pass: false, reason: 'execution failure; not a CSV observation'};
+  return actual === expected
+    ? {pass: true, reason: 'exact canonical CSV, including order and whitespace'}
+    : {pass: false, reason: 'CSV stdout differs from canonical expected output'};
+}
+// Exercise the production grader before executing any candidates.
+assert.equal(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b\n', 0).pass, true);
+assert.equal(grade('b,a\n', 'a,b\n', 0).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade('a,b', 'a,b\n', 0).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade('a,b  \n'.trimEnd(), 'a,b  \n', 0).pass, false);
+// Valid but noncanonical quoting is deliberately outside the acceptance contract.
+assert.equal(grade('"a",b\n', 'a,b\n', 0).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b\n', 1).pass, false);
+const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('eval/cases.json', 'utf8'));
+const conditions = [
+  {id: 'historical-default', source: 'eval/baseline.mjs', args: []},
+  {id: 'baseline', source: 'app.mjs', args: ['baseline']},
+  {id: 'default', source: 'app.mjs', args: []},
+  {id: 'full', source: 'app.mjs', args: ['full']},
+  {id: 'without-unicode', source: 'app.mjs', args: ['without-unicode']},
+  {id: 'without-escaping', source: 'app.mjs', args: ['without-escaping']}
+];
+const hashes = Object.fromEntries(['app.mjs', 'eval/baseline.mjs', 'eval/cases.json', 'eval/run.mjs']
+  .map(file => [file, hash(fs.readFileSync(file))]));
+const [mode, file] = process.argv.slice(2);
+if (!file || !['--run', '--replay', '--replay-saved'].includes(mode)) throw Error('Usage: node eval/run.mjs --run|--replay|--replay-saved FILE');
+if (mode !== '--run') {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
+  if (mode === '--replay') assert.deepEqual(saved.hashes, hashes, 'source/fixture drift: saved results belong to another revision');
+  else console.log('Historical replay: ratings only; current source identity is NOT asserted.');
+  assert.deepEqual(saved.cases, cases);
+  assert.deepEqual(saved.conditions, conditions);
+  assert.equal(saved.results.length, cases.length * conditions.length);
+  let i = 0;
+  for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const row = saved.results[i++];
+    assert.equal(row.case, task.id);
+    assert.equal(row.condition, condition.id);
+    assert.deepEqual(row.rating, grade(row.stdout, task.expected, row.status, row.error));
+  }

+} else {
+  // Freeze all inputs and source identities before running the first candidate.
+  const record = {runtime: process.version, hashes, cases, conditions, results: []};

+      rating: grade(run.stdout, task.expected, run.status, error)});
+  }
+  assert.deepEqual(hashes, Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(hashes).map(file => [file, hash(fs.readFileSync(file))])));

+    const rows = record.results.filter(row => row.condition === condition.id);
+    console.log(`${condition.id}: ${rows.filter(row => row.rating.pass).length}/${rows.length}`);
+  }
+  if (record.results.some(row => ['default', 'full'].includes(row.condition) && !row.rating.pass)) process.exitCode = 1;
